title: Reese Witherspoon Draws Comparison To Power's Gianni Paolo From Raising Kanan's Malcolm Mays [Watch]
htmlContent:
Malcolm May, known by his stage name Lou Lou Thomas, graced the set of the widely popular talk show, "The Crew Has It," as the most recent guest, sparking excitement among fans and viewers alike. Hosted by the dynamic duo of Gianni Paolo and Michael Rainey Jr., the show is known for its engaging discussions with prominent figures in the entertainment industry. Lou Lou Thomas, a rising star in the music industry, brought his vibrant energy and captivating persona to the show, leaving a lasting impression on the hosts and audience.

During the interview Mays spoke about Paolo's personality from his interactions with him.

"So he's cancerous he grow on you I noticed his cancerous, like he's infectious he's like your level of positive energy is like one of them people that like like on some Reese Witherspoon type s***. Like you come in n*** and it's like bubbly and it's like I can't even deny You either you full of s*** or you really a nice altruistic person and I'm still figuring it out but it feels pretty genuine," said Mays.

"The first time I met you I'm gonna be real the first time I met you bro you was walking with a bad b*** in in a New York Park. He was walking with a bad one bro, and she was tall too, so I was like you look really like the man. You're far nicer like he like yo resting b*** face is cold though."

Speaking for Witherspoon, TikTok revealed a groundbreaking partnership with Kevin Mayer and Tom Staggs' Candle Media in a major announcement at the Cannes Lions festival. The collaboration will initially focus on Hello Sunshine, owned by Candle Media and led by renowned actress Reese Witherspoon, as they aim to discover talented but underrepresented independent authors and literary material from the vibrant #BookTok community on TikTok.

The partnership aims to leverage Candle Media's expertise in storytelling across various business units to introduce new and captivating premium content and branded entertainment. Hello Sunshine, under this collaboration, will tap into the vast pool of TikTok creators to identify promising authors and provide support for the development of high-quality film, TV, and premium audio projects. The goal is to uplift and amplify the voices of underrepresented storytellers, bringing their narratives to life. Witherspoon, an Oscar-winning actress and the driving force behind Hello Sunshine, expressed her excitement about the partnership and its potential impact.

As for Raising Kanan, acclaimed actor Wendell Pierce, known for his iconic role in "The Wire," and talented actress Erika Woods, recognized for her work in "Blue Bloods," have joined the Season 3 cast of Starz's "Power Book III: Raising Kanan" in recurring roles. Pierce takes on the character of Ishmael "Snaps" Henry, a revered figure on the streets with a history as a bank robber and influential dealer. He now serves as a mentor and financial backer for emerging talents like Kanan, while Woods portrays Stephanie 'Pop' Henry, Snaps' partner and beloved wife, adding depth and complexity to the storyline.
